summary.zh: 往下拉，顶部像一层橡皮膜被手指拽出一个包，手往哪边偏包就往哪边鼓，越拉越难拉。过了阈值松手，膜弹回来晃两下变成加载条，新消息从 0 高度“挤”进列表。
summary.en: Pull down and the top behaves like a rubber membrane bulging under your finger, following it sideways and resisting more the further you go. Release past the threshold and it springs back, wobbles into a loading bar, and the new message squeezes into the list.

technique.zh: 膜是一条 SVG path：两侧高度 e、手指处鼓到 d，用两段三次贝塞尔连起来。拉动距离过一遍橡皮筋函数 M·(1 − e^(−x/M))。松手后 d 和 e 各挂一个弹簧，刚度不同，所以中间和两边不同步，看起来在晃。
technique.en: The membrane is one SVG path: edges at height e, bulging to d under the finger, joined by two cubic Béziers. Pull distance goes through a rubber-band curve M·(1 − e^(−x/M)). After release d and e each ride their own spring with different stiffness, so the middle and the edges wobble out of sync.

desc.zh: 拉过这个距离松手才刷新

adapt.zh: 把 done() 换成你的数据请求回调；膜和列表是分开的两层，列表可以是任何滚动容器（记得只在 scrollTop 为 0 时接管下拉）。
adapt.en: Replace done() with your fetch callback. Membrane and list are separate layers, so the list can be any scroller (only take over the pull when scrollTop is 0).
